blockers: Synthetic rehearsal is never physical identification evidence.
Camera coverage lacks valid frames, span, rate or gap continuity in a measurement phase; inspect before fitting.
Raw telemetry lacks samples, span, rate or gap continuity in a measurement phase.

timing.clock_basis: host monotonic receipt and board counters reported separately

acknowledgements.basis: first exact last_seq receipt relative to the host write interval
acknowledgements.limitations: Receipt-domain bounds only; not physical actuation, board acceptance time, one-way latency, or sensor age. Unobserved sequences may reflect telemetry or log loss; later sequences do not prove a skipped command was accepted.

interpretation: Collection quality is not model qualification. Independent metric/angle references and held-out prediction checks are still required.

questions: Compare measured camera cart displacement against step count by direction and speed; qualify metric anchors first.
Estimate actuator tracking/lag only within camera sampling and clock uncertainty; report unresolved fast dynamics.
Fit raw encoder versus independently referenced pose by angle and approach; hold out repetitions; keep hanging phase separate.
Compare near-upright free releases with the frozen hinge-friction law; test stiction/hysteresis before adding model terms.
Summarize 100 Hz host timing and observed sequence acknowledgements; do not infer physical or one-way delay.
Validate the assembled model on coupled runs reserved as validation; do not tune on those holdouts.

model_update.next_step: Review real training/validation evidence, fit supported terms, implement missing plant terms if supported, then export a new versioned profile and test RigCartpoleEnv.
